searches.reason: Investigate whether SASRec’s single-negative training objective misses competitive ranking errors, especially in Electronics. Seek practical multi-negative or listwise objectives with false-negative control; compare using the fixed macro validation HR@10, since training margins do not establish generalization.

searches.reason: Explore replacing a single history representation with distinct persistent-interest and current-intent representations. Look for causal, time-aware models that distinguish repeated recent interests from isolated purchases and model complementary next purchases using observed histories, without assuming purchase satisfaction is labeled.
searches.query: sequential recommendation 2024 2025 2026 multi-interest intent disentanglement time aware complementary purchases persistent transient interests

searches.reason: Explore a content-and-transition model that distinguishes specific functional or artistic matches from broad relatedness. Prioritize methods trainable from item titles, descriptions, and training interactions without pretrained weights; treat compatibility and prerequisites as uncertain evidence rather than supplied labels.
searches.query: sequential recommendation 2024 2025 2026 joint text collaborative transition graph item titles descriptions complementary recommendation trained from scratch
